t.NIACINAMIDE.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.NIACINAMIDE.eff.0: No known side effect in normal use (CIR, 2005); clinical tests showed no significant irritation, sensitisation or photosensitisation.
t.NIACINAMIDE.found.2: Products for dark spots and pores
t.NIACINAMIDE.summary: A form of vitamin B3; a skin conditioning agent.
t.NIACINAMIDE.what: According to CosIng it smooths the skin surface.
